# Wood hoe

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-wood-hoe.md" title="Wood hoe"><img src="icons/44.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Wood hoe"></a>

Tills grass or dirt into farmland and cuts leaves faster. Tools currently have no durability loss.

| Property | Value |

| Tags | `burnable` |
| Tool tier | Wood |
| Effective mining speed | 2× on suitable blocks |

| Furnace fuel duration | 10 seconds |

## Furnace fuel

One item supplies **10 seconds** of burning fuel. Use it in a [Furnace](Item-furnace.md) or [Cooker](Item-cooker.md) for smelting or cooking.
